scope: Read-only source audit of recognizable scenic architecture selection. Not a fresh browser/render review or loaded triangle/material budget test.
findings: The legacy plot label villa_2 is mapped to villa_3 before fetching regional scene roots. No villa2 near mesh is expanded into distant geometry.

Missing plot models produce a load failure, while missing pavilion models remain empty; neither path constructs a procedural replacement building.
Landscape helpers construct terrain, walls, bridges, vegetation, streetlights, furniture, boats and cable-car vehicles; no second recognizable house/station shell was found.
releaseAction: Preview already routes outer architecture through regions-far; production still points at regions intentionally until all exact approved near/far packs are published. Parent owns the final unconditional far switch.
